text:
Asha: Quick async check — what I did / blockers / today:
- Did final pass on hero CTAs and uploaded three variants to the content queue.
- Drafted benchmark post but need engineering perf numbers to fill the results table.
- Prepared banner assets and responsive slices.
Blocker: need embedding latency numbers from eng (staging + prod) to finalize benchmark graphs and decide on model fallback.

Theo: Which env should I pull from, staging or prod?

Miguel: Staging first is fine for drafts, but we need prod p50/p95 for the post. I've added the draft to Notion: https://notion.so/rw/marketing/bench-draft — please comment.

Jamie: Sending final CTA copy now, small tweak to the H2. Also flagged SEO meta in the Notion doc.

Theo: I grabbed staging numbers: p50 85ms, p95 230ms for embed call (128 token). Prod under current load is p50 ~90ms, p95 ~310ms. I'll attach traces to the PR and add a short note about degradation under burst.

Jamie: Final copy pushed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-content/pull/412 — @Theo can you drop perf note in PR, @Miguel can you double-check SEO macros?

Miguel: Will review PR this afternoon. Also, can we queue a CDN invalidation after publish for /landing/*? Recommend manual invalidate to be safe.

LaunchBot: CDN invalidation request received for /landing/* scheduled 2024-05-24T15:30Z :white_check_mark:

Theo: Added perf snippet suggestion to PR: 
```
if (latency > 400) {
  use_model('gpt-lite')
}
```
— fallback reduces p95 by ~40% in my local sim.

Asha: Great — blocker cleared on CTA. Plan: aim to publish 16:00 PT tomorrow. I'll merge after Miguel's review unless there are objections. :thumbsup:

Miguel: Sounds good, will review by 14:30 PT.

Jamie: I'll stand by for merge, will do final smoke check after publish.

Asha: thanks team — small follow-up: @Theo, can you also add a short note about request batching in the PR? just 1–2 lines.

Theo: Will do in next 10m. :rails:
